en: Vulture, yes. Why?
Needed to see one today. Uh, so... Your name?
People call me Returner.
Oh, you use nicknames, I see.
Rodion.
Nice to meet you, Rodion.
You make... Clothes?
I'm a seamster. Make all sorts of new clothes, um, I also patch and repair things... Holes in boots, rips on vests, worn down dust coats. I fix that...
It's mostly my husband who handles customers... I just work. But I've been having trouble with materials, so I have to be more active, uhm, in talking to people now... Not my forte...
Trouble with materials?
Well, I use a lot of cloth, linen, leather, little specialized tools for cutting, sewing, patching... Stuff that's rare to come by.
It's why I need to trade with and hire Vultures to get these things for me. Never enough inventory... S-sorry, I'm just whining now...
Who's your husband?
Oh, it's Yefim... H-He's a trader, stays near Sontse, East of here. He sells armor, accessories and stuff. He looks scary... But he's kind. You should meet him.
Wish he would join the Rada like I did. But he... Has his own way of helping out.
Having a husband – unusual around here.
I guess before this whole thing with the Mist it was super common? But yeah, not many folks in Zalesye have someone they can rely on like that...

We never married like the Church would describe it, though. I call Yefim my husband anyway. He calls me Ves. I really like that. Having someone to lean on at the end of each day... It's a privilege. I wonder if others around here even think about it...
Does he help with work?
Very much. I help him too. We complement each other's supplies, a-and he handles some of my clients...
You can tell I'm not super good with people, can't you. I hope that's no bother, I don't mean anything by it...
What's he like? As a person?
I-I... Don't know how to respond to that. I know you didn't mean it that way, but... It's like, too intimate to say?
It's a weird feeling, I know. But let's talk about something else, ok?
You're a member of the Rada?
Yes, I am. Best decision I've made – the only hope for this region is if we stick together, after all...
Why? Would you like to know more?
About the Rada...
Yes?
I've got to get going.
What's the Rada, exactly?

Uhm. I'm not the best at explaining things, but... We're a group that wants to organize Zalesye. Bring folks together. It started like a sort of town assembly – a get-together of skilled folks who built our shacks, grew our food, protected us from Mutants...
It's all modeled after the way things used to be before the War. How do I say this... If everyone's work is connected, and not just for the individual... Things get, like, much better. Exponentially.
Connected how?
Part of a larger whole...? Like, if we can really look at the work everyone has to do in order for us to survive, and really make sure everyone's pulling their weight...

If we make sure that all work that gets done is useful and properly balanced between people, we can be more productive, and then actually flat-out give stuff away to folks who need it, and then they can become part of this whole cycle. That's the basic idea...? I'm not very eloquent...
What is your role in the Rada?
Well, I'm a seamster, so I just make clothes. I make more than we think we'll need, if I can, since there's always a couple vagrants in need of warmth, you know...
I'm supposed to talk to people about the Rada, too... I guess I'm doing it with you, now. But it's usually the others who bring new folks in...
Do you get paid for your work?
Well, kinda. I get a portion of the food and necessities that we have stashed in our bunkers and distributed among our leaders.

This is, like, the main point of contention. We can't afford to just store all our stuff in one place or it'll get raided for sure. So the leading members have to keep a network of items... And guard them. This causes, uhh, fights. Criticism. But, yeah, I guess that's kinda like payment.
Has the Rada been growing?
Not really. We've stagnated a bit these past couple of years, what with the Acolytes taking over some of our responsibilities.
They're like, occasional allies, and friendly competitors in a sense... Kind-hearted people whose work is always tied to God and to the power of the Church as an institution. A pre-War monolith.
When push comes to shove, I don't think that structure really has our common interests at heart.
About something else.
I've gotta go now.
Oh, good – are you a Vulture? Name's Vesna. I make clothes. We should, uh, talk...
H-Hello.
Oh, hi.
Need to talk a bit.
Can we talk?
Got something to ask.
I'd like to trade.
I've some stuff to trade.
Wanna see what you have.
Oh, ok, we can trade!
Sure, please look at what I have.
There's some stuff I need to trade, too.
Cool, let's...
Alright.
See you around.
'Til later, I guess.
Alright, bye.
Come by again.
I'll do it.
Thank you. Let me know how it goes.
I'll think on it a bit.
Sure... Please don't take too long.
Not interested. Got anything else?
Thanks.
Wasn't a big deal.
I'll get them for you.
Nice! I'll be waiting. Be safe.
Have to think about this.
I understand...
Sorry – got anything else?
Thank you.
Glad to help.
Need help with anything?
Any requests for a scavenger?
Need to hire a Vulture?
I need more resources to make clothes for the squatters in Dubravka... Can you help me find these items?
I’m short a few items for work... The Vulture who used to get them for me went missing... Are you interested?
Thank you! Hope it went smoothly. Here's what I promised.
Good to see you're in one piece. Here's your reward.
This'll help my work a lot. Here you go.
A Rada cache has just been overrun by Bandits. Would you clear it for us? We have to salvage those materials...
There’s been more than a spot of trouble with our supplies, on account of a group of Bandits... If you could deal with them, I’d appreciate it...
You're a lifesaver. Here's your share.
Great! Now, as promised...
Good. This will really help us! Here's your reward.
Afraid I don't have anything else for a scavenger, right now.
I don't have other requests right now. Check later.
Don't need anything else; we'll talk later.

Had some questions.
I'll get to it later.
Making progress.
Oh, of course...
H-hey, Vulture... How's the "hunt" g-going?

If you can get some clothes from all nine groups in Zalesye, it'd be wonderful for me. I'd have lots to study from, copy, adapt, recycle. It'd help the business a lot. S-so... Y-you in? I promise I'll reward you fairly... It's an investment, after all...
That's okay!... You can, ehm, y-you can deliver my request bit by bit... Come by every time you have something you want to d-drop off, and I-I'll take it off your hands...
Oh, u-um... I m-mean, I guess it is... Can't hide that... It's clothes for all the factions after all... B-but I hope you'll reconsider! Please take some time to think it over!...
Uh, w-well, I'm in need of some, uhm, inspiration... Work's been drying up, I-I need more clients from more factions... Gotta help Yefim make sales, too, so...
Three things, really...
So I can give you the request little by little?
Very unusual request.
Second: inspiration. I'd like to come up with clothing that can fit a variety of needs while still being resistant against dirt, radiation, Mist... And it needs to be cheap, too. So I need ideas.
Also, I figured this is a good a time as any to put in this request... Since I've been saving up, and I know it's been t-tough for Vultures lately, so... Y'know...

First: studying. There's many different styles and techniques people use to make their clothes, just like any other gear, like the stuff you carry around. I have to learn from looking, touching, experimenting.
I'll get going, then.
Don't get what you'll use other people's clothes for.

Is it? I g-guess people don't usually take an interest in this stuff like I do... M-maybe that's my strength, that I'm willing to do nothing but this, while for most others, even us Rada, it's like a shitty chore...
I'd have to kill people for all these different sets.
And last but not least... More inventory means more materials to recycle, reuse, and so on. Useful for stuff like patching up old clothes.
Yeah! Sh-shouldn't be an issue. Just tell me which faction you got and I'll mark it down for y-you...
Okay... T-take care out there, let me know if there's anything I can help with...
I won't know where it's from, and I know you're bound to find some stuff on corpses... I won't pry, but... Please, Returner. Don't harm anyone unless you have to...
Well, n-no, please don't kill anyone on my account... I'm sure there's plenty of ways to get everything without bloodshed, trading, or... I'm s-sure you can find a lot of it just, uh, lying around...
I wanted samples, p-pieces of clothing from every faction there is. Just enough to figure out how they're made, find new techniques. I figured that's where a V-Vulture comes in...?
T-take care, Returner...
Oh, of course... What is it?
Glad you're satisfied.
Well, yeah... Oh! H-here, that reminds me, your reward... I h-hope you'll come around again...
Thank you so much, Returner. I'm gonna take my time analyzing all of these... There might be some better products to trade for next time you're around...
This was a pain... Pay up.
Oh, y-yay! Seems like it's all here... So many great samples.
S-sure, here you go... I, uhm, I hope you'll still be around for more jobs, i-if I need you?...
Got religious clothes from the Acolytes.
Thanks! Hm, they're plainly-made, like Commonfolk clothes... But they have a certain visual appeal... Humble but conspicuous at the same time...
Got some Bandit clothes. They have... An odor.
Thank you, Returner... They do have an odor, don't they... I suppose there's not much to be done about that... And the clothes themselves are very haphazard.

Thanks! I guess they are pretty standard, but there's still something to learn from how they make it under bad conditions... You'd think they don't get to choose the cloth, for one, but then you realize... S-sorry, I'm running my mouth.
Here's some Commonfolk-style clothes. Pretty standard.
Managed to find some Gunner clothes. Not easy.
Yeah, I can imagine...  Hopefully it wasn't a risk for you? They have some very high-quality stuff, now that I look closer... I wonder how they even got this in the first place...
Got my hands on a Mechanist's work clothes.
Good job, Vulture! I can smell the grease and sweat... But yep, work clothes through and through. I'll give them a wash and see how I can maybe make some stuff for them in the future...
Here's some stuff Mudlarks wear.

Thanks, Returner. Hm, they clearly don't care much about this clothing thing, huh? I get the impression they'd be walking around naked if they could get away with it... Might happen sooner or later, too...
Awesome! Wow, this is good stuff. A bit beat up, but it's real War-era gear... Protective but light... Pretty high-quality for something that probably had to be mass-produced...
Snagged a Palatine's military gear.

Thanks! Saves me the trouble of annoying them for some extra garments, haha... I've always liked these, how they're inspired by traditional farmer attires and such... Though I suppose some of this is "form over function" and all...
Got some clothes from the Rada folks.
Found some typical Vulture clothing.

That's great, Returner! I'm glad you didn't have to give up something of yours for this. Let me take a look and figure out what sorts of adaptations you guys will make to help you walk the wastelands all day...
I'm done with all you asked me.
I think I've got everything you asked.
Got all faction clothes for you.

Gunners and Palatines use military and police gear from before the War, some of which they've creatively adapted to support their roles, real or imagined. There's other examples, but you get the gist...
O-oh, sure... What is it?
Y-yes! Of course, I have to see all sorts of garments and understand, l-like, how they're made and stuff. And why they're made that way.

F-for example, right? Commonfolk and Mudlarks are forced to work with simple fabrics, but their handiwork is easy to patch up. Mechanists can throw overalls or a coat over anything else and be ready for a productive day, because that stuff handles spillage and stress well.
About something else.
If we make sure that all work done is useful and not just for accumulation, we can be more productive, and even flat-out give stuff away to folks who need it.
Back to my own work...
About your work...
You said you wanted to "study" different clothes...
Mutants have been tearing up our supplies during the night... We need someone to hunt them down, or we'll lose too much food.
We've seen more Commonfolk deaths from Mutant attacks in the last few weeks... Please search for the creatures that did it and kill them!
Oh, you did great! I hope they didn't bite you!
Thank you, Vulture! I hope the reward is good enough.
I'll take care of it.
Okay, good, but stay safe!
Have to think about this.
Uhm, o-ok... I might have to ask someone else...
Sorry – got anything else?
You're lucky I'm cheap.
Always a pleasure.
